notes.content:

notes.title: 1.1.1 hotfix
notes.content:
* Fixed an issue where unlocked tips could be read.
* Removed the ability to return to the title screen to fix an issue where returning to the title screen during a gear minigame would cause the novel to be skipped.

notes.title: Mini-Game Skip & Russian Language Support & more!
notes.content:
I'm excited to deliver the first major update news from "Gears Story"!

Mini-Game Skip Feature

The mini-games, long criticized for their redundancy, can finally be skipped.

The function of the highest-priced item, the "Golden Wrench", has been changed as follows:
Before: The path to the goal is visualized for 100 moves.
After: Becomes inoperable and automatically moves to the goal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877675/2fa5ed90beee92d60a68c6f0720a3b9ec4ad727a.gif

Tips Tree Feature Added

I have changed the display of the massive number of tips items to a tree view, categorized for easier browsing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877675/be75beed0af67002c22c2f1be08231662dd2cbbd.png

Support for Russian Language

I have added Russian to the languages supported.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877675/89a5f840793944719c81c38427bc3ae92d24add7.png

Main Visual Change

The main visual of the game has been updated with newly drawn pixel art.
Here is the full image.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877675/ff453399ebd4022d82230dc9ef7b6590578ddeba.png

notes.title: Release! and notes
notes.content:
After 108 days of development, "Gears Story" is finally released!

For those who haven't purchased it yet, those who have already purchased it and are about to play, and even those who have already finished it, there's something I want to share.


Conclusion: The price of this game will not increase

This game includes an "Afterword," and it seems that the way I wrote it was a bit confusing, leading to some misunderstandings among some players.

I wrote the following in the Afterword:

The next installment, "Shoe-Straings Story," will of course share the same universe and is expected to be more than ten times larger in scale. Accordingly, we plan to revise the pricing, and it will take some time before release.

This does NOT mean that "Gears Story" is scheduled for a price increase.

It simply means, "While we released this work at $0.99, the lowest price possible on Steam, the next work, 'Shoe-Strings Story,' will be a bit more expensive." The price of "Gears Story" will continue to be offered at $0.99.

I apologize for any confusion my unclear wording may have caused!!


That being said, enjoy the game!

Based on the store page, this game might seem like a serious novel game.

However, I intended to structure the story so that it could be enjoyed by anyone, much like a pop Hollywood movie.

It's sprinkled with humor throughout, interspersed with serious developments, and ends with a surprising climax.


It's a shame to just stack it!

For those still hesitating to buy or considering stacking it, I'll give a small spoiler to nudge you: in this game, there's a scene where the protagonist [spoiler]trips on hallucinogenic drugs[/spoiler]!

There are no direct sexual depictions, violent scenes, or grotesque portrayals, so everyone can play with peace of mind. I would be delighted if you could try playing it at least once.

Once again, I sincerely hope you enjoy my work, "Gears Story".
